frontend/tests/smoke-core/tenant-viewpoint-switcher.spec.ts test 4 had been red since W4: the user created in test 3 had a membership but no role binding, and W4's HasRoleBindingInTenant gate refuses such logins. The fix assigns the tenant's provisioned 租户成员 role in test 3's create flow. This repairs a pre-existing red spec; it does not weaken any assertion.

Premise delta — secure-action verification: DELETE /system/tenant/:id is wrapped in SecureActionMiddleware, so the first destructive request of a browser session is answered HTTP 403 auth.operation.verification_required and the frontend opens the SecondaryVerifyModal; the token is then cached. The spec handles this (waitForResponse registered before the confirm click; on 403 it fills the modal) — coverage the packet did not anticipate.

Premise delta — member add scenario is remove-then-re-add: ensureTenantMembership auto-provisions an active membership for every user created under tenant scope, so the member picker's candidate pool only contains users whose membership was previously removed, and a platform-pool user is refused by W4's tenant.member.user_not_in_tenant rule. The spec therefore seeds a tenant-owned user via API (X-Tenant-Id header), removes the non-owner member, then re-adds them through the selector.

Premise delta — plan lifecycle: plans cannot be deleted (retire is terminal) and accumulate across runs, so the plan drawer asserts the four builtin codes individually instead of a total count, the custom plan row is asserted by its raw code (planLabel falls back to the code for non-builtin plans), and afterAll retires leftover active plan_console_* plans.
